reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism involves the integration of radio fixed wireless (RFW), free space optics (FSO), and switched flex grid wavelength division multiplexed (Flex-WDM) fibre optics using optical-spectrum-as-a-service (OSaaS) for confluent mesh networking. The ISAC coupling mode is based on the convergence of sensing and communication signals in a unified transmission network.
